## Acceptance
- [ ] Assigned, approved scope only; issue claimed; independent branch/fork
- [ ] No other active PR implements the same task
- [ ] Functional controls and accessibility exercised
- [ ] Data migration/backup and Crystal Cluster invariants respected
- [ ] Static, browser and Manifold tests on the exact head are reported
- [ ] Physical printing, Cura import and safety are not falsely certified
- [ ] Version, changelog, What's New and handover updated when required
- [ ] Owner/reviewer approval requested; **no automatic merge**
